cases.purpose: In a caller made multithreaded by a freestanding loadable, ns unshare user fails with status 1 and the kernel EINVAL text, leaves the user namespace unchanged, and matches an independent ctypes unshare(2) from a two-thread process; a single-threaded shell making the same request succeeds.
cases.oracle: unshare(2) man page: CLONE_NEWUSER fails with EINVAL if the caller is multithreaded; the strerror text and the native result come from an independent Python ctypes call to libc unshare(2) made from a process that has a second thread, and a single-threaded shell making the same request is the control.
cases.comparison: Exact expectation for status and output derived independently of the candidate; raw stdout, stderr and fixture files are retained as diagnostics.
cases.script:
guard_guest() {
  local token vendor virt inside outside length extra
  local -a uid_rows
  [[ -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || return 125
  IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || return 125
  IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || return 125
  [[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || return 125
  (( UID == EUID )) || return 125
  if (( EUID == 0 )); then
    mapfile -t uid_rows </proc/self/uid_map || return 125
    (( ${#uid_rows[@]} == 1 )) || return 125
    read -r inside outside length extra <<<"${uid_rows[0]}" || return 125
    [[ $inside == 0 && $outside == 2000 && $length == 1 && -z $extra ]] || return 125
  else
    (( EUID == 2000 )) || return 125
  fi
  virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || return 125
  [[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || return 125
}
guard_guest || { printf 'refusing non-fixture guest\n' >&2; exit 125; }
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
/usr/bin/gcc -shared -fPIC -nostdlib -O1 -fno-stack-protector -fcf-protection=none -o thr.so thr.c || { echo gcc-failed; exit 98; }
nat=$(/usr/bin/python3 -I -c '
import ctypes, os, threading
ev = threading.Event(); t = threading.Thread(target=ev.wait); t.start()
n = sum(1 for _ in os.scandir("/proc/self/task"))
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
r = libc.unshare(0x10000000)
e = ctypes.get_errno()
print("threads=%d rc=%d errno=%s msg=%s" % (n, r, __import__("errno").errorcode.get(e), os.strerror(e)))
ev.set(); t.join()')
echo "native-control $nat"
msg=${nat#*msg=}
cat > cand.sh <<'EOS'
nth() { local k v rest; while read -r k v rest; do [[ $k == Threads: ]] && { THREADS=$v; return; }; done </proc/self/status; }
ino() { /usr/bin/readlink /proc/self/ns/user; }
before=$(ino)
nth; echo "threads=$THREADS"
if [[ $1 == multi ]]; then
  enable -f ./thr.so thr; echo "enable rc=$?"
  thr; echo "thr rc=$?"
  nth; echo "threads=$THREADS"
fi
ns unshare user 2>err.txt; echo "ns unshare user rc=$?"
echo "err=$(< err.txt)"
echo "user-ns-changed=$([[ $(ino) != "$before" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
EOS
echo "--- single-threaded control"
"$BASH" --noprofile --norc cand.sh single 2>&1
echo "--- multithreaded caller"
"$BASH" --noprofile --norc cand.sh multi 2>&1
echo "message-matches-native=$([[ $(< err.txt) == *": $msg" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
cases.stdout:
native-control threads=2 rc=-1 errno=EINVAL msg=Invalid argument
--- single-threaded control
threads=1
ns unshare user rc=0
err=
user-ns-changed=yes
--- multithreaded caller
threads=1
enable rc=0
thr rc=0
threads=2
ns unshare user rc=1
err=cand.sh: line 10: ns: unshare: Invalid argument
user-ns-changed=no
message-matches-native=yes
